claim.text: The finite Antihydra parity acceleration and P1/P3/P4 monitors reproduce their intended bounded arithmetic; broader interpretations remain unproved.
claim.scope: Uploaded snapshot and b0=4 through 10 million autonomous b-steps; 100k-step P4 calibration only.
assumptions: Uploaded archive is the supplied project snapshot; no Git history is available.
Macro-to-TM rules are assumed beyond the bounded raw-TM smoke checks.
forbidden_promotions: No proof of infinite non-halting, Bernoulli mixing, logarithm law or novel cryptid.

specification.intended_object: T(b)=floor((3*b+4)/2), its exact parity stream, the associated +2/-1 counter and finite monitors.
invariants: Chunk endpoint and parity word agree with direct arithmetic.
Changing chunk boundaries preserves the word and endpoint.
First negative counter time is retained.
P4 controls use the same word extraction and family.
known_answer_cases: b=4 has first parities 0001 and endpoint 36 at 4 steps.
An all-odd stream crosses below zero at t=1.
Constant tables are degenerate, not evidence of independence.

implementation.commit: No Git commit: uploaded ZIP SHA256 b414234e7597bcc5d9693bf4545b75954e9eecaf9e99fa36d91a8870b6904a32 plus supplied patch
implementation.environment: Python 3.12.14, NumPy 2.3.5, Python integer backend, no Lean/lake
implementation.representation: Byte-per-parity array and exact arbitrary-precision integer endpoint.

metric.name: Typed finite result: parity hash, counter/drawdown, P3 band ratio, descriptive P4 family statistic and matched-null tail rank.
metric.units: Macro steps; integer counter levels; dimensionless ratios.

black_box: 16 unittest methods passed; original three raw-TM smoke checks passed.
structural: All 10 Lean files are byte-identical to the snapshot.
Importing the edited scripts executes no simulation and writes no files.
property_based: 60 seeded random starts, horizons and chunk sizes.
metamorphic: Chunk concatenation, restarts and exact endpoint transport under dyadic shifts.
fuzzing: Invalid data, zero-length runs, negative parameters, constant and alternating streams.
historical: First 4 Antihydra parities, 50,000 direct arithmetic steps, 10-million-step reported records.

matched_baselines: Direct integer recurrence for the acceleration.
99 iid bit streams at N=100000 for all 120 overlapping-window tests.
negative_controls: Alternating parity sequence has strong dependence.
All-odd sequence exposes a halt; constant tables are marked degenerate.
controls.compute_parity: Null controls match N and extraction. No speed comparison with the original GMP run is made.
controls.parameter_parity: Null controls match maximum window 16, all 120 pairs, seed recorded.
controls.sampling_parity: Overlapping windows are used in both observed and null streams.
controls.data_access_parity: Same observed parity words; no withheld oracle data.

preregistration.prediction: This is a retrospective audit manifest assembled after reproduction, not a new preregistration. Supplied claims predict exact bounded agreement.
preregistration.primary_metric: Exact finite word/endpoint agreement and reproduction of numerical record values.
preregistration.uncertainty_method: Exact integer comparison on bounded tests; Monte Carlo rank resolution 1/100 for 99 controls.
preregistration.kill_condition: Any parity/endpoint mismatch retires the generator correctness interpretation for that domain.
preregistration.stop_condition: One 10-million-step reproduction and one 100k-step 99-control calibration; no horizon escalation.
preregistration.promotion_rule: Promote only to measured finite agreement; retain asymptotic and universal claims as H/A.

independent_witnesses.name: Direct arithmetic and naive contingency oracle
independent_witnesses.origin: Different code paths, same reviewing author; not external independent replication.

claim_to_artifact_map: Finite parity generation -> direct-reference tests and generation hash.
No-go scope -> theorem quantifiers in AntihydraOuroboros/Basic.lean.

transformed: Open discovery question becomes an evidence-audit contribution.
lost: No new machine discovery is claimed.
remainder: Universal macro proofs and novelty checks.

lost: No loss claimed within checked arithmetic.
Full parity arrays are reproducible but not bundled.

remainder: Status refresh, equivalent-machine checks and proof search.

result.observed: 16 new tests and all three raw-TM smoke checks passed; 10-million-step P1/P3/P4 values reproduced; 100k matched P4 tail rank 0.84.
result.effect_size: Finite exact agreement; no discovery-rate or performance advantage measured.
result.uncertainty: Bounded numerical evidence; Lean/lake unavailable, no Lean rebuild.
retired_claims: General no-go for all semilinear invariants inferred from the affine counter-time result.
CRT as proof of single-orbit independence.
active_remainder: Quantitative dependence control for the specific orbit.
